Investors in a company brought an action against the accounting firm based on undisclosed liabilities. The Irvin group sued the auditing firm, MFSL, which I'll abbreviate is for, short for Mann, Frankfurt, Stein, and Lipp, saying they failed to perform a balance sheet audit on a South Texas music, slash, South Texas record and tape company for the proposed purchaser, Robert Gullerman.
